title: Section · Stages list (growth ladder, 01→04)
description: Vertical growth ladder with 4 stages (01–04). Each stage has a left rail with stage eyebrow, big number, and a 4-tick progression scale (lv1 lights 1 tick, lv4 lights all 4 + accent glow). Main area: title + users pill + lead + capability chips. Stage 01 uses plain chips; stages 02–04 use additive chips with '+' prefix to signal new-capabilities-on-top-of-previous-stage. Typically paired with decorative.cycle-strip above + decorative.callout-band below.

source.adapted_from: designer kit 2026-05-24 → light tokens. Accent normalized to shared secondary CTA palette.
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-24 — stages-list adopted as canonical SMB/growth pattern

notes: 4 stages by design — the lvN modifier on .stage controls the rail opacity + tick count, so changing stage count requires editing both the chip-of-ticks AND the modifier class.
Chips in stage 01 are 'baseline' (no +); chips in stages 02–04 use additive '+' prefix to read as 'and this on top'.
Empty chip slots auto-hide via :has(> span:empty:last-child) — admins can ship 3 chips per stage just as easily as 5.
On ≤880 px the stage layout flips to single column: the side rail (eyebrow + num + scale) becomes a horizontal bar above the main content.
